about: Cases for a command that runs a project's checks (conformance/README.md, How a project's run is judged). Expected batches, records, counts and statuses are written from the rules, never taken from a kernel.

files.dodona.toml:
[project]
name = "p"
config = "0.2"

[[binding]]
name = "checks"
capabilities = ["obligation.enumerate", "obligation.check"]
provider = "t.check"
match = ["m/*.txt"]

[[binding]]
name = "intents"
capabilities = ["intent.index"]
provider = "t.intents"
match = ["intents/[0-9]*.md"]

cases.name: both obligations checked and recorded
cases.why: Nothing has a result yet: both are checked in one batch, and both verdicts recorded.
